title: Program error
description: Terminal and non-terminal error taxonomy shared by direct execution, provider execution, verification and the integration suite. Every consumer maps its internal failures onto these codes; no consumer invents a local code. The retryability field, not the code, decides what an orchestrator may do next.

allOf.$comment: An indeterminate outcome is resolved by inspection, never by repeating the operation. retry_same_step and every resume kind are structurally unavailable here, so the never-blind-retry rule is enforced rather than merely described.

D-010. identity_bind calls register(), which mints a NEW agent, and bindings are immutable with no unbind. Retrying an unconfirmed failure can mint a duplicate agent and strand the first. Retry is therefore permitted only against a confirmed revert, and even then only after identity_preflight re-reads the current token/resource; the job schema enforces the preflight half by forbidding a resume directly into identity_bind.
An orphaned binding has no exit through resumption: there is no unbind, so the only recovery is minting a fresh agent. Marking it retryable would loop a consumer forever.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Additive: new codes are a minor version bump, removing or repurposing one is a major bump.

retryability.description: Governs orchestrator behaviour. retryable: the same operation may be repeated automatically. terminal: it may not. requires_user_action: a human decision or authorization is needed. indeterminate: the outcome is UNKNOWN and repeating the operation risks duplicating irreversible or paid work; it must be resolved by inspection, never by an automatic retry.

message.description: Human-readable summary. Must already be redacted: no secrets, keys, credentials or reusable payment authorizations.

step.description: Job step this error is attributed to, when it arose inside a job.

recoveryAction.description: The exact next action. The brief requires an explicit recovery action, so this is required on every error rather than being left to a caller to infer from the code.

resumeFrom.description: Job state or step to resume from, when kind implies a resume.

evidence.description: Pointers to artifacts that substantiate the error. References only; never inline secret material.

revertConfirmed.description: True ONLY when a transaction receipt was actually read and its status was reverted. It is never inferred from a timeout, an RPC error, or an unread receipt. It is the sole thing that can make an identity binding failure retryable.

details.description: Free-form structured context. Guarded against secret material by the same rule as the envelope.

source.description: Which side produced the error. Provider-reported errors are evidence, not truth (D-006).

$comment: Invariant: any error whose retryability is indeterminate MUST carry recoveryAction.kind = inspect_settlement_before_any_retry or inspect_job_status. E_PAYMENT_SETTLEMENT_UNKNOWN is the canonical case and encodes the never-blind-repay rule from PROGRAM-CONTEXT section 12.
